Karmine Corp (previously known as Kameto Corp) and occasionally abbreviated as KCorp or KC is a French organisation which currently plays in the LEC.

On October 18th, 2023, Karmine Corp announced the acquisition of the League of Legends EMEA Championship slot of Astralis. [1]

See also: Karmine Corp: History
